_comment: Single-best-answer items exempt from the 15% length rule in check-revisions.mjs. Value is the reason: "numeric" for short number/value options that must not be padded; otherwise a one-line note for human review.
PN-S10-06: Single-word drainage terms (serous, sanguineous, serosanguineous, purulent); padding the distractors would itself be a cue. Correct option is only 4 characters longer than the longest distractor.
RN-S13-15: Single-word antidote names (naloxone, acetylcysteine, flumazenil, vitamin K); padding the distractors would itself be a cue. Correct option is 4 characters longer than the longest distractor.
